subject: POC access & evaluation plan - Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + POC access & evaluation plan

Hi Sarah — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC started. Please confirm owners/timeline and any missing items.

Summary of call:
- Goal: 2-week POC to validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization and triage routing.
- Success criteria (high level):
  * generate summaries with >= 85% clinician-acceptance on a 100-sample blind set
  * end-to-end latency < 300ms median for single-request demos
  * no PHI exfiltration concerns (data remains in your VPC during Private trial)

Proposed evaluation plan (attached: redwood-poc-eval-plan.xlsx):
1) Week 0: Access & provisioning — SSO invites, API key for dev sandbox, IP allowlist, sample dataset upload.
2) Week 1: Model tuning & integration — our engineers provide reference client, batching guidance; Nimbus runs 100-sample evals.
3) Week 2: Metrics review & decision — review acceptance, performance, and ops needs.

Ownership & contacts:
- Nimbus PM / exec sponsor: Sarah Jenkins (you)
- Nimbus eng lead for integration: Tom Lee
- Redwood POC lead: Marissa Cole (me)
- Redwood infra/keys: Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com)
- Redwood eng contact for SDKs: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwoodinference.com)

Access items we need from you to provision test credentials:
- List of public IPs or CIDR ranges to allow (for IP allowlist)
- SSO SP-initiated or IdP metadata (SAML or SCIM) to invite your users, or emails for users to invite directly
- Preferred project name for isolation and any compliance flags

What we'll provide from Redwood by EOD Wednesday:
- a masked API key / credential file (poc-credentials.txt) + instructions for rotating
- SSO invite link & SP metadata (if you want Redwood to configure)
- Shared eval plan (attached) and a sample Postman collection for smoke tests

Next steps / asks:
- Can you confirm the IP ranges and who on your side will hit the API (Tom or someone on infra)?
- Confirm that the success criteria above capture your goals or suggest edits by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this kicked off.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood-poc-eval-plan.xlsx (POC timeline + test plan)

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@nimbushealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 18:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC access & evaluation plan

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Tom and I validated the high-level success criteria; a couple notes from our security/compliance review (we attached the Nimbus checklist):

- Security asks: we need your latest SOC 2 Type II report and data retention settings for the trial environment.
- SSO: we prefer SAML SSO and will send metadata. We also need SCIM provisioning if possible so we can manage user accounts centrally.
- IP allowlist: our infra team will provide ranges, likely 3x /24s, by EOD Wednesday.
- Timeline: Week 0 access ok for us; target demo/end review on June 9 (two weeks from Mon 6/1).

Tom will be the primary eng contact for provisioning (tom.lee@nimbushealth.com). Please route the API key and any infra notes to him and to Rishi.

I attached Nimbus security checklist (nimbus-security-checklist.pdf) for any gaps — happy to review offline.

Sarah Jenkins
Director of Product
Nimbus Health
sarah.jenkins@nimbushealth.com

Attachments: nimbus-security-checklist.pdf
